versions.content: EcucAbstractReferenceDef properties The abstract class EcucAbstractReferenceDef is used to specify the common parts of all reference definitions. EcucAbstractReferenceDef is an Identifiable so it is mandatory to give each reference definition a name. Also EcucAbstractReferenceDef is in- heriting from EcucDefinitionElement so for each reference definition it can be specified how many such references might be present in the same configuration con- tainer later in the ECU Configuration Value description.
